label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Some good news to start with: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. She's a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years at a consultancy in Coventry, so she knows what homeowners need from a beam calculation and a set of drawings: clear answers, delivered on time. She'll be helping with the calculation work, and I'm genuinely pleased to have her on board.

Now the less comfortable part. Over the last two months, some of you waited far too long for your calculations. In September and October our turnaround for beam calculations and drawings stretched to five or six weeks. That was my doing. I said yes to more work than I could handle on my own, and I was doing site visits through the day and calculations late into the night. It wasn't fair on you, and I'm sorry. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting with the steel already ordered. We got it to them in three days, but only after they'd had to chase us twice. They deserved better, and so did everyone else who was left waiting.

Here's what's changing. Our target is now 10 working days from instruction to calculations and drawings. If your job is in the queue and you're wondering where it stands, message me directly and I'll tell you exactly where it is. You shouldn't have to chase us.

We're also changing how site visits work. From 1 January 2027, the first site visit will cost £95, and if you go ahead with the job, that £95 comes off your fee. We've offered visits free for a while, but about a third never turned into work, and that isn't sustainable for a small practice trying to give proper attention to every client. Any visit already booked when this post goes up stays free, whatever its date, so if you've been meaning to get us out to look at your wall or loft, book now.

Thank you for your patience and for sticking with us. If you see Priya on site, say hello. She's going to be a great addition.

reasons: It invites waiting clients to ask for an update but does not reassure them that their jobs are progressing.
